additional_info.subject: Findings( Need to discuss with Ingo)
RE: 0401839 - ID0401839-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R5 170001806]   Charge point rejects the SetUserPrice message with PropertyConstraintViolation CRM:02023000445
additional_info.body:
Hi Rasmus,
We have reviewed the logs you shared, and our chargers operate using the OCPP 1.6J protocol. Any violations of the tariff information rules will be rejected by the charger. The issue here is that the backend is violating the instructions outlined in the attached snapshot. Please refer to it, and let us know if you have any further questions or need additional clarification.
The message :
[2,"f08e0311-fa1b-4d51-b2e7-0c781ecd6633","DataTransfer",{"vendorId":"TariffInformation","messageId":"SetUserPrice","data":"{\\"idTag\\":\\"04E25E92701D95\\",\\"price\\":{\\"da\\":\\"Standardpris: 0,92 DKK pr. kWh, 0,26 DKK/kWh. Prisen er gældende for brugere på denne ladestander. Lader du igennem en anden udbyder, vil prisen ved udbyderen være gældende.\\",\\"de\\":\\"Standardpreis: 0,92 DKK pro kWh, 0,26 DKK/kWh. Abonnement- oder Roaming-Gebühren können anfallen. Überprüfe deinen Plan oder frage bei deinem Roaming-Partner nach Details.\\",\\"en\\":\\"Standard price: 0,92 DKK per kWh, 0,26 DKK/kWh. Subscription or roaming rates may apply. Check your plan or with your roaming partner for details.\\",\\"fr\\":\\"Prix standard : 0,92 DKK par kWh, 0,26 DKK/kWh. Des tarifs d'abonnement ou d'itinérance peuvent s'appliquer. Consultez votre
The above message contains special character and they are not in ASCII standard and the sting is to long.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
